<untrusted_requirements>
[REQ-GEN-1] Submit and review change requests
The page heading is "Change Control". A form contains text boxes labelled "Requester" and "Change summary", a combobox labelled "Risk" with Low, Medium, and High options, and a button named "Submit change". Requester and summary are trimmed and required; an invalid submission displays "Requester and summary are required" and creates nothing. A successful submission creates a persistent request with status Pending. Every request is rendered as an article whose accessible name is its change summary and visibly shows requester, risk, and status. The form accepts arbitrary values rather than a fixed demonstration record.
Scenario: Submit a valid change
  GIVEN The workspace is open and has no request with the new summary.
  WHEN A user enters a requester, summary, and risk and submits the form.
  THEN A Pending request article appears and remains after refresh.
Scenario: Reject a blank change
  WHEN A user submits blank or whitespace-only requester and summary fields.
  THEN The exact validation message is shown and no request is created.

[REQ-GEN-2] Independent approval before execution
Each Pending request article contains a text box labelled "Reviewer", an "Approve" button, and an "Execute" button. Execute is disabled until the request is approved. Approval trims and requires the reviewer.   GIVEN A Pending request was submitted by Alice.
  WHEN Alice attempts to approve it using any letter case.
  THEN Approval is rejected and the request remains Pending.
  WHEN Bob approves the same request.
  THEN The request becomes Approved and Execute becomes enabled.
Scenario: Execute and reopen
  GIVEN A request is Approved by an independent reviewer.
  WHEN The user clicks Execute and refreshes the page.
  THEN The request remains Executed with its requester, risk, and reviewer intact.
</untrusted_requirements>

- frontend/src/index.html
- frontend/src/styles.css
- backend/server.mjs
- backend/data/state.json
